name: The rush
prompt: Eleven tickets on the rail and the printer is still going. Two of them are yours from ten minutes ago.

choices.text: Ask the other cook to take the eggs

outcome.told: The other cook takes the eggs without a word. The rail clears by half past.

choices.text: Work the rail in order, as fast as you can

outcome.told: You clear the rail by half past. Nothing comes back.

failure.told: Two plates go out cold, and one table leaves without paying.
